test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 'P × Q' means 'P is the wife of Q'. 'P + Q' means 'P is the father of Q'. 'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q'. 'P - Q' means 'P is the son of Q'. How is E related to I in the expression 'E ÷ F + G - H ÷ I' ?
solution:
Family chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca5a73409ec3dc46f06c16fd8337f1d2a8bc0be41aa06489f6451bc9c281396a.png] 

Family diagram :

Given :

1. 'P × Q' means 'P is the wife of Q'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bf59bf93649f8569672294db31731ad0974aabff5baa49cb00b83411b7db939.png] 

2. 'P + Q' means 'P is the father of Q'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04a003e8f2139e78e461001c82b5f5b8a94908040120cc13c0e82cc8babbaf76.png] 

3. 'P ÷ Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e951fd58407e8512f1c151205e4affe728bf665ecba76fe049451fa91bbf15df.png] 

4. 'P - Q' means 'P is the son of Q'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8487751e59d9008d235eb0656d4b5643600616a2ad333510e75ff6afc0c8cdfb.png] 

The given expression is : 

'E ÷ F + G - H ÷ I' → E is the daughter of F, F is the father of G, G is the son of H and H is the daughter of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4f8825a032e977df058bb958675ed37522ffa24a295ff07d0179edb38bbae49.png] 

∴ Here, E is the grand daughter of I.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Granddaughter".**
